rules.rule: Watch (L3) needs early holder density that holds through the first fade; an mcap spike alone isn't enough.
KOTH loss + curve progress reversing + holder bleed = Pass (L1).
Copycats appearing often mark peak attention for the original.
Solada headline 24h volume can be stale post-graduation; check real pool flow over the last 6h.
Graduation alone isn't a signal: JUICE, FEED, HERO, BEAST all faded to 19-30k ADA with 60-80 holders after pools opened.
Pools with an ADA side under ~11k swing 30-80% on a handful of wallets; holder count is the signal.
Price rising with flat holders = Tiny lottery (L2) at best.
Linked flip pair u8a2m6+u978t4 and snipers u9w6dd/uytg09zr/uyyyjqps in the first block = rotation risk; watch whether they sell into the run.
First-block sniper full exit = kill trigger; IAGONAUT faded 47.8k→32.2k within ~45 min after top sniper uytg09zr sold out (Oct 17).

Holding-tier shape: only names with 120+ holders, ADA-side ≥25k and 6h buys > sells qualify for paper tickets; post-graduation names under ~11k ADA side with 6h price down >40% (HERO -76%, JUICE -41%, ROBIN -55%) are Pass regardless of 24h headline gains.

Promo-pop entries: don't ticket a name whose last 6h gain came from a promo/perk announcement on flat holders. Wait for the pullback and a re-hold. BOLT opened at 530k right after the copy-trade-bot promo (+12%) and hit its 450k kill within ~2h (-20.6%) while holders barely moved.
Team airdrops inflate holder counts: holders gained during a team airdrop window (CLOVE 3M+ airdrop, Oct 17) don't count toward rule k or L3 holder growth.

Solana-side snipe hunt: Solada's holder count for Solana-side coins mixes both chains (CORE shows 119 on Solada vs ~35 Solana holders on pump.fun). Score Solana traction on pump.fun/Helius Solana-native holders, excluding the Solada escrow wallet HCYvN1... and deployer A1qaJW....

Count-based flow and holder leaks: 'buys > sells' counts only if h6 price change is also >= -10% (FTR showed 2,665 buys/1,584 sells over h6 while price fell 34%; BOLT 104/49 at -14.5%). Close an open ticket early when holders fall at two marks in a row and price is below entry, instead of waiting for the kill line: FTR bled 18,434 -> 18,111 -> 17,599 holders into its -34.5% kill, and CLOVE 128 -> 126 -> 123 (closed -12.7%).

Swarm launchers: early-swarm keys now launch coins themselves. uyt8xs9q (early in CRAWJI) launched PPC at 8:37 PM with u9w6dd/uxfernv7/uxz6fvju in its first blocks; u9rwdkfjtr launched HUMAN and DINO 8 min apart and uxz5cts5ww launched RED and RBULL 6 min apart, with flip pair u8a2m6+u978t4 early in all four. A launch whose launcher is a swarm key, or with 2+ swarm keys in its first 10 buyers, is L1 until it shows 60+ holders outside the swarm list.
